titleDisposition.specificRisk: soil-health-l3 title phrase “Ukwakha Umhlabathi” is a possible physical-building reading; suggested exact anchor is “Building Soil”. Intro L3 scope issue is already captured by the existing 15-field repair packet. Other inspected title targets preserve recognizable scope; generic “uncertain” in the older audit means not individually lexical-cleared, not a demonstrated mismatch.

bodyAndTitleFindings.source: Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow.
bodyAndTitleFindings.currentTarget: Ukuthi iyiphi indlela efanele umhlaba wakho kuncike emhlabathini, emthambekeni, ekugelezeni kwamanzi nasekugelezeni kwamanzi ezikhukhula zemvula.
bodyAndTitleFindings.issue: Target expresses drainage and storm flow with potentially overlapping “water flow” phrases. The source treats them as separate site factors.
bodyAndTitleFindings.minimalSafeguard: Retain the exact technical anchors “drainage” and “storm flow” in that sentence until a Zulu term pair can be checked; retain all surrounding soil/slope/adviser/line/overflow/receiving-point instructions unchanged.

bodyAndTitleFindings.source: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
bodyAndTitleFindings.currentTarget: Gcina i-spillway ingenamfucumfucu, futhi unakekele izitshalo ezimboze ibhange ngendlela eshiwo emklamweni. Ungatshali izihlahla odongeni lwedamu lomhlabathi.
bodyAndTitleFindings.issue: “ibhange” can read as a financial bank. The target’s later earth-dam-wall prohibition is intact, but does not make the bank-cover noun unambiguous.
bodyAndTitleFindings.minimalSafeguard: Keep “bank cover” exact English while preserving the clear-spillway instruction, design qualifier, and no-trees-on-wall prohibition.

bodyAndTitleFindings.source: South Africa has two native honeybee subspecies.
bodyAndTitleFindings.currentTarget: INingizimu Afrika inezinhlobo ezimbili zezinyosi zoju zomdabu ezingaphansi kohlobo olulodwa.
bodyAndTitleFindings.issue: Current phrase says two native honeybee types beneath one species; plausible concept, but subspecies is technical taxonomy and exact rank should not be inferred from this wording alone.
bodyAndTitleFindings.minimalSafeguard: Use “subspecies” in English in this sentence; leave native status, count two, and honeybee identity intact. Do not broaden range/movement permissions.

bodyAndTitleFindings.source: Mulching and Cover Crops: Protecting and Building Soil
bodyAndTitleFindings.currentTarget: I-Mulch Nezitshalo Zokumboza Umhlabathi: Ukuvikela Nokwakha Umhlabathi
bodyAndTitleFindings.issue: The literal “building soil” rendering may be read as physically constructing soil rather than improving soil health. The body’s source-bound ecology content does not remove that title ambiguity.
bodyAndTitleFindings.minimalSafeguard: Keep “Building Soil” in English in the title while retaining localized “Mulching and Cover Crops” and “Protecting”; this is a narrow title safeguard, not a fluency judgment.

bodyAndTitleFindings.source: Zones and Sectors: Organising Your Farm by Energy

bodyAndTitleFindings.issue: Title names visit frequency (zones) but omits the energy/sector dimension. Lesson body carries both; title still narrows the frame.
bodyAndTitleFindings.minimalSafeguard: Preserve “energy” as an exact English title anchor until localized wording can express both zones and incoming sectors/energies.
